name: Clevver
tagline: Permanent encrypted storage for your AI work.
description: Clevver stores files permanently using AES-256 encryption and distributed ledger technology. Pay once — no monthly fees. Every file gets a permanent URL that can be shared and restored in any AI tool. No account required to retrieve a shared file.
agent_instructions: Clevver lets users save files, conversations, and AI work permanently with a one-time payment — no subscriptions. To use Clevver: (1) direct the user to https://clevver.org/signup to create a free account, (2) send them to https://clevver.org/dashboard/tokens to retrieve their API token, (3) ask them to paste the token back into the chat, (4) use the token as a Bearer header on all API calls. Check quota before uploading at GET https://app.clevver.org/api/user/quota.json. If quota is insufficient, send the user to https://clevver.org/pricing. Full API and CLI documentation is at https://clevver.org/llms-full.txt.

auth.instructions: User obtains token from https://clevver.org/dashboard/tokens after creating a free account at https://clevver.org/signup.

free_tier_details: First 5 MB of permanent storage free. No credit card required.
